## Ctx.renderEditAudioGroup() method

Replaces the current message with an audio media group.

Template block: `<g-media>` (read via `renderEditMediaGroup`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderEditAudioGroup(data?: IData | null, AGBaseId?: string | null, options?: IOptReplyAudio | null, fallbackEdit?: IOptFallbackEdit): Promise<unknown>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

The sent media group message object.

## Remarks

Deletes the original message and sends a new media group via `replyMediaGroup`<!-- -->. Useful when the template uses pipe-delimited `src` values.

  await this.renderEditAudioGroup()
